steps.message: Open the dialer app. Clear any pop-ups that may appear by granting all permissions that are required.

Execute: adb shell "pkg=$(cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.DIAL | tail -n 1 | cut -d/ -f1); echo DIALER_PKG:$pkg; for perm in android.permission.CALL_PHONE android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG android.permission.WRITE_CALL_LOG android.permission.READ_CONTACTS android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO android.permission.ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS android.permission.ADD_VOICEMAIL android.permission.USE_SIP android.permission.PROCESS_OUTGOING_CALLS; do pm grant $pkg $perm 2>/dev/null; done; am start -a android.intent.action.DIAL"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pkg=$(cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.DIAL | tail -n 1 | cut -d/ -f1); echo DIALER_PKG:$pkg; for perm in android.permission.CALL_PHONE android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG android.permission.WRITE_CALL_LOG android.permission.READ_CONTACTS android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO android.permission.ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS android.permission.ADD_VOICEMAIL android.permission.USE_SIP android.permission.PROCESS_OUTGOING_CALLS; do pm grant $pkg $perm 2>/dev/null; done; am start -a android.intent.action.DIAL""

extra.finish_description: Dialer app opened and required permissions were granted to clear permission pop-ups.

extra.task_text: Open the dialer app. Clear any pop-ups that may appear by granting all permissions that are required.
